column4: Accelerating Resurgence of Industries and Services through Exports (ARISE PH 2.0)
column6: This project builds upon the achievements of the ARISE Plus Philippines project to enhance MSME export competitiveness through tailored interventions, AI-based tools, and expanded market access. It aligns with the Philippine Export Development Plan (PEDP) 2023-2028, focusing on strengthening local industries, improving global market integration, and fostering a business-friendly environment. Key initiatives include capacity-building activities such as product certification support, intellectual property protection, and targeted training for exporters, particularly in the food, beauty, and personal care sectors. The proposal also emphasizes expanding market access through free trade agreements (FTAs), economic impact studies, and trade negotiations, particularly with the EU, Peru, Spain, and Italy. The project also strengthens the linkage of regional export efforts to international markets. Further the project aims to enhance the digital trade ecosystem by maintaining platforms that streamline FTA utilization and compliance, ultimately driving inclusive and sustainable export growth.
